title: Simulator-as-Proxy World Model for Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32786v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video world models for robots are increasingly conditioned on a simulated or rendered proxy of the scene, on the assumption that the video will show what the proxy shows. Testing this assumption requires a proxy whose state is explicit and can be perturbed. We present SimPWM (Simulator-as-Proxy World Model): given a calibrated camera, it represents, from the first frame alone, the robot by its 3D model and the objects the gripper may touch as 3D points; a rule-based simulator with no trained parameters moves them under the actions, and a video model renders the result. SimPWM returns the realistic video together with the simulated state. We then freeze the simulated objects while the arm moves as recorded and check whether the video still shows the object lifted. translated_title: 面向机器人操作的“模拟器作为代理”世界模型
translated_abstract: 机器人的视频世界模型越来越多地以场景的模拟或渲染代理作为条件，其假设是视频将呈现出代理所呈现的内容。要验证这一假设，需要一个状态显式且可被扰动的代理。我们提出了SimPWM（模拟器作为代理的世界模型）：给定一个经过标定的相机，它仅从第一帧出发，用机器人自身的3D模型来表示机器人，并将夹爪可能接触到的物体表示为3D点；一个不含任何训练参数的基于规则的模拟器在动作作用下移动这些元素，随后由视频模型渲染出结果。SimPWM同时返回逼真的视频和模拟的状态。接着，我们冻结模拟中的物体，让机械臂按照记录的动作运动，并检查视频中物体是否仍然被抬起。在来自未见过的环境的DROID片段上，机械臂和物体给出的答案有所不同。使用三种基础视频模型中的每一种，机械臂都能跟随代理（机器人IoU为0.75-0.78……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出SimPWM，用一个无需训练参数的规则模拟器作为显式代理世界模型，仅凭第一帧即可表示机器人与物体，并首次系统验证了视频世界模型是否忠实跟随模拟代理——结果显示机械臂能紧密跟随代理，而物体的行为则可能出现偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SimPWM, a training-free rule-based simulator serving as an explicit proxy world model that represents the robot and objects from the first frame alone, and systematically tests whether video world models faithfully follow the simulated proxy—finding that the arm closely tracks the proxy while object behavior may diverge.
